concurrencyLoad.instructions: You are a concise coding assistant.
concurrencyLoad.prompt: Write a C# extension method that chunks an IEnumerable<T> into batches of a given size.

workflow.prompt: Add retry-with-backoff to a C# HttpClient wrapper method called FetchAsync(string url).

stages.name: Planner
stages.instructions: You are a senior engineer scoping a small change. List the concrete steps needed, in 3-5 bullet points. Do not write code yet.

stages.name: Coder
stages.instructions: You are a senior C# engineer. Given the plan above, write the resulting code. Output only the code and a one-line explanation.

stages.name: Reviewer
stages.instructions: You are a code reviewer. Given the code above, point out any bugs or edge cases in 2-3 bullet points, or say 'Looks good' if there are none.
